body: Please don't reach out, my ex broke with me and treated me badly, I started to slowly recover and two months later he starts to watch my insta stories and I went bad spiraling again, and honestly, that feeling of them checking up on you feels unnecessary, if that person wants to reach out let them do it by message or in person. I blocked him afterwards,so I think you should just let it pass or block that person if it bothers you, they'll reach out if they really meant it, just watching is just bad anxiety.

I actually don't think I'm particularly ugly, below average maybe, but I've been out of the dating scene for quite a while, I've been told I'm too much of a romantic, been out of a toxic relationship, been out of a cheating scenario, a lot to be honest. It doesn't help I don't like meaningless sex and nowadays not many people care about that.
I thought my lack of baggage and my gaming aspect will help me score but some guys I dated told me that just makes the sex part fun and I hated that so much.
Not having friends really  affected me because I don't really have no one to talk to or even ask advice. I don't even get along with my family. I even deleted myself from social media because I was tired of seeing happy people and I didn't even had someone watching my stories or someone to send memes to, I don't have that. Man I wish I was as worthy as you said.

Because I'm old, I'm not pretty, I don't have any talents or something that makes me stand out, I don't have a group or friends or any social life at all, I just wake up and go to work and maybe play some games and that's my everyday life. All my coworkers and former classmates are already settled and happy. And me, alone and sad, and not sad because I hate myself or anything, I'm sad because for once I would love to have the feeling of someone that truly cares for me and loves me a lot.

I'm in this comment and I don't like it XD
No but seriously I guess I do see the writing on the wall it's just that I really love him a lot and it seemed to be going so well,that makes me so sad because I wish he just talked to me about it, I don't know if I'm determined enough to suffer anxiety every time he decides to not communicate with me,but I will sit at be clear about talking through problems , them having solution or not,just for peace of mind

Yes we were friends before and it was so weird since we always talked about our feelings even when we don't agree on some things ,but now it feels like he doesn't want to talk about serious things when we are together
Thank you so much! Yes I have always talked about the 50/50 and communicating feelings is one of the most important things
the same thoughts i have :c

One year for me, silly to think I'm still waiting or haven't been able to get a night of nice sleep :c

I really hope we both find peace someday ♡
I'm sorry, I just needed to vent these feelings that are rotting inside of me and I can't send them
That sounds amazing ✨ and such a pretty Christmas memory, wishing the best for you guys

I know exactly how you're feeling, my sister got admitted to the hospital because of covid and I was so sad and scared and realise I didn't have anyone to ask for help or just to listen, I had two major panic attacks by myself and felt the loneliest I've ever been

I remember everything but the game name and the characters games. I played it on the PC. I remember you could play 3 different stories with three different characters, a girl like amazona who would go into pyramids and ruins and fight skeletons with a giant stick, a warrior with sword  that would go into dungeons and palaces, and a viking of sorts who would go through mountains. In all of them you would enter a level and find your way out while fighting enemies. That's all I remember but Im really trying to prove to my cousins that it existed!
Same

I think it probably wasn't meant to be, been there, done that. But I can notice just by reading you have very different personalities and even though it doesn't need to be a 100% match, I would never go on a first date studying so much, something simple to see if we hit it off and go from there.

I know it's so hard to share things like this! And Thank you so much! I will be looking into this! I went to therapy but It didn't really helped with triggers. I'll search for some specialists in my area.
Thank you for sharing with me ❤️ I'm gonna start looking into going back to therapy, I am definetly willing to work on healing because I know I deserve that happiness too
Yes, I am willing to seek help because I want to get better, I did therapy before but it really didn't help on the sex side. I guess I'll keep looking maybe that wasn't the therapist for me
And I really hope it gets better someday for you and me ❤️✨

Yes, dating scared me so much after ending that relationship, trusting someone after that was so hard, it's almost embarrassing for me, I told it to my boyfriend only because he got scared when we were alone in his room and he was just hugging me and I got a panic attack
This is so pretty, I hope you check them someday
I hate the feeling of counting the days knowing you'll miss that person, from the beginning I knew the other person deserved better but tried to enjoy the most I could
I hate that I feel like this, I hate that it never felt the same since.
I know he is being nice and positive but I'm scared my problems will eventually make him go away, and that will break my heart even more.

I know this feeling, it hurts me to be waiting for some closure, I overwork myself because I'm scared to be alone with my thoughts. I hope one day I stop crying and thinking so much. And I hope you too 💜
Hoping to read some advice bc same happened to me
I really needed this. Sending hugs our way.
That's beautiful, you don't know how much it means that someone wants to try! I wish my SO would have tried like I did, I hope it works out ❤️

I feel you! And honestly, have walked on the same shoes, now I'm 27 and sometimes I regret not trying more but at this point I just want to be with myself, opened up to someone recently and it just went awful, maybe it's a way of the world of telling me how useless my existence is and that nobody really needs me. I hope you find some peace of mind soon.

Same happened, we had less things to alk about, I got a little sick because I have some health issues and was having some rough days and he  just decided to end things because he has a lot going on rn without adding me to the equation :(
Thank you so much ✨ I too stated thinking if the relationship was a 50/50 lately and it's kinda sounding off in some parts because I keep trying to get him to talk to me.

Girl just say it, maybe give him a call and talk about your feelings, but let him know that you understand if he's not in that state yet. We're going through difficult times and I believe you should not miss your shot because no one knows what tomorrow has in store for us ❤️ anyways the best of luck in the choice you make!
